title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 2 — Fast Matchup Switching Step 9
problem: Selected CFB Game Total Page 2 renders traverse Page-1 presentation installers and the full inherited router chain before reaching the already-frozen selected-game runtime, adding avoidable rerun overhead when switching matchups.
root_cause: The production entrypoint has no selected-CFB fast path above the current NBA overlay, so exact selected events pay routing and Page-1 installation work that does not own Page-2 behavior.
patch: Add one routing-only Step-9 overlay above the current production router. For an exact selected CFB Game Total event, re-read current query identity and render the frozen Step-8 Page-2 runtime directly with the preserved navigation shell. All other routes delegate unchanged to the current production owner.
acceptance: exact selected CFB Game Total bypasses the prior full router chain
selected Page 2 does not run Page-1 presentation installers
non-selected and non-CFB routes delegate unchanged to the prior production owner
event identity is re-read on every render so sequential matchup switches cannot reuse stale selection
Step-8 Page-2 runtime remains frozen and unmodified
